title: Convergence verification of the Collatz problem
summary: Introduces small O(N) lookup tables replacing huge O(2^N) precomputed tables for Collatz verification. Achieves 4.2e9 128-bit numbers/sec on CPU and 2.2e11 on GPU.

title: Improved verification limit for the convergence of the Collatz conjecture
summary: Pushes Collatz verification limit to 2^71 using optimized sieve and GPU computation.

title: 3x+1 search programs
summary: Original paper establishing computational techniques for Collatz searches including sieve methods.

title: GPU-accelerated Verification of the Collatz Conjecture
summary: Achieves 5.01e11 64-bit numbers/sec on NVIDIA GTX TITAN, 278x speedup over CPU.

title: An improved algorithm for checking the Collatz conjecture for all n < 2^N
summary: New algorithm that takes less than 2x longer to verify convergence for all n < 2^{N+1} vs n < 2^N.

title: Chronological Verification of the Collatz Conjecture using Theoretically Proven Sieves
venue: Electronic Journal of Mathematical Analysis and Applications
summary: Novel sieve bitsets of O(2^m) elements with multi-core distributed verification. 1.3e9 128-bit integers/sec on Intel i7.
